questions.question: What is the primary function of a Work Order System in a railway/metro workshop?

options.A: To issue railway passes to employees
options.B: To authorize work execution and serve as a cost unit for collecting labor, material, and overhead expenses
options.C: To record daily gate attendance of workshop staff

questions.question: In Indian Railways and Metro Railway workshops, how many digits are standardly used in the unified Work Order Coding System?

options.A: 4 digits

questions.question: In an 8-digit Work Order Number, what do the first two digits represent?

options.A: Shop Code / Main Series Head

questions.question: What is a 'Standing Work Order' (SWO)?

options.A: A work order for temporary emergency work
options.B: A permanent work order allotted for booking indirect costs, routine maintenance, and shop overheads
options.C: A work order issued only to external contractors
options.D: A work order for manufacturing new Metro coaches

questions.question: Which department in the workshop originates and issues the Work Orders for production and overhaul?

options.A: Stores Department

questions.question: Direct Work Orders are issued for work that:

options.A: Is related to general shop cleaning
options.B: Can be directly attributed and charged to a specific product, job, or coach overhaul

questions.question: Work Orders under '70 Series' in Railway Workshop Accounting are generally reserved for:

options.A: POH of Electric Locomotives
options.B: Manufacture of components/store items for stock

questions.question: Work Orders under '80 Series' are reserved for:

options.A: Capital Works, Rolling Stock Programme (RSP), and M&P works

questions.question: Work Orders under '90 Series' are allocated for:

options.A: Manufacture for internal store stock
options.B: Deposit works executed for foreign railways, public sector undertakings, or private parties

questions.question: Which series of Work Orders is generally allocated for Shop Oncost (Indirect shop expenses)?

options.A: 00 / 10 Series

questions.question: What is the purpose of a 'Route Card' attached to a Work Order?

options.A: To guide delivery trucks outside the workshop
options.B: To specify the sequence of operations, shops/sections involved, and movement of raw material
options.D: To issue fuel for road vehicles

questions.question: Which document is used to draw raw materials from the Stores Depot against a specific Work Order?

options.A: Job Card

questions.question: Labor cost is booked to a specific Work Order through which document?

options.A: Job Card / Time Ticket / Tally Card

questions.question: What is 'Shop Oncost'?

options.A: Cost of raw material purchased directly
options.B: Indirect expenses incurred within a specific shop section (e.g., shop lighting, consumable stores, supervision)
options.D: Cost of transporting coaches between zones

questions.question: What is 'General Oncost'?

options.A: Expenses common to the entire workshop (e.g., CWM office salary, main gate security, yard lighting)
options.B: Cost of cutting tools used by a turner
options.C: Incentive bonus paid to direct workers
options.D: Cost of steel sheets used in coach fabrication

questions.question: How is Oncost (Overhead) applied to a direct job order in railway workshop costing?

options.A: As a predetermined percentage on Direct Labor cost
options.B: As a flat ₹100 fee per job
options.C: It is not added to job cost

questions.question: What does POH stand for in railway workshop operations?

options.A: Partial Operation Handling

questions.question: What does IOH stand for in coach/rake maintenance?

options.A: Initial Operation Handling

questions.question: POH of Metro Railway rakes / BG coaches is booked under which category of work order?

options.A: Revenue Work Order (Repair & Maintenance)

questions.question: What is a 'Sub-Work Order'?

options.A: A subsidiary work order opened under a main work order to collect cost for specific sub-assemblies or operations
options.B: A work order given to a subcontractor without approval
options.D: A work order meant for canteen purchase

questions.question: Who maintains the 'Work Order Ledger' to summarize total expenditure on each work order?

options.A: Workshop Accounts Office (WAO)

questions.question: What happens when a Work Order is 'Closed' by PCO?

options.A: No further material or labor can be legally booked against that Work Order
options.B: All scrap generated is thrown away
options.C: The job card is destroyed immediately

questions.question: Which document is issued by the Shop to PCO after completion of physical work on a Work Order?

options.A: Work Completion Advice / Certificate

questions.question: What is 'Work-in-Progress' (WIP) in workshop accounting?

options.A: Cost of jobs that have been started but are not yet completed at the end of the accounting period
options.B: Total salary paid to retired workers
options.C: Cost of scrap stored in depot
options.D: Cost of unissued raw material in stores

questions.question: If unserviceable scrap material is recovered during coach overhaul, how is it credited under the Work Order System?

options.A: Credited to the specific Work Order via Advice Note of Returned Stores (Form S-1539)

questions.question: Advice Note of Returned Stores is sent to Stores Depot along with scrap using which form number?

options.A: Form S-1539

questions.question: What is 'Proforma Invoice' issued for in 90-series Work Orders?

options.A: An estimated cost invoice sent to an outside party to collect advance payment before starting work

questions.question: Which accounting head is debited when raw material is issued for a 70-series Work Order?

options.A: Workshop Manufacturing Suspense Account (WMS)

questions.question: What is WMS in railway workshop costing?

options.A: Workshop Manufacturing Suspense Account

questions.question: Why is WMS called a 'Suspense' account?

options.A: Because its clearance is kept in suspense until work is completed and final expenditure is cleared to final heads
options.C: Because it belongs to confidential funds

questions.question: In an 8-digit Work Order number '50 123 45', what does the first group '50' indicate in standard workshop terminology?

options.A: POH of Coaches / Rolling Stock repair head

questions.question: What is the primary risk of leaving completed Work Orders open for long periods in the accounting system?

options.A: Misbooking / unauthorized booking of labor and material costs

questions.question: Which document lists all active and authorized Work Orders open in a workshop for booking during a month?

options.A: Work Order Schedule / Master Work Order List

questions.question: Who is responsible for auditing the Work Order Ledger and issuing monthly Workshop Account Current?

options.A: Workshop Accounts Officer (WAO)

questions.question: What is 'Direct Material' in Work Order costing?

options.A: Material that forms an integral part of the finished component or overhaul work
options.B: Cotton waste used for cleaning hands
options.C: Kerosene oil used for floor cleaning

questions.question: What is 'Indirect Material'?

options.A: Material used in supporting operations that cannot be directly linked to a single specific job (e.g., lubricants, cleaning rag)

questions.question: Indirect Material costs are charged to:

options.A: Standing Work Orders (Shop Oncost / General Oncost)

questions.question: What is 'Direct Labor'?

options.A: Labor directly engaged in modifying, assembling, or repairing a specific job card component
options.B: Labor engaged in sweeping the workshop yard
options.C: Labor engaged in driving office car

questions.question: What is 'Indirect Labor'?

options.A: Labor providing auxiliary services (e.g., crane operator, millwright maintenance worker, tool room attendant)

questions.question: How are Idle Time costs accounted for under the Work Order System?

options.A: Booked against specific Idle Time Standing Work Orders under Shop Oncost
options.B: Debited to worker's personal bank account
options.C: Charged to direct capital RSP work orders

questions.question: What is 'Developmental Work Order'?

options.A: Work Order opened for trial manufacturing, modification design, or experimental project work
options.B: Work Order for staff residential colony repairs
options.C: Work Order for buying food items

questions.question: Which Work Order series covers 'Manufacture of stock items for General Stores'?

options.A: 70 Series

questions.question: When a Metro coach undergoes modification under an approved RSP (Rolling Stock Programme), expenditure is booked under:

options.A: 80 Series (Capital / RSP Work Order)

questions.question: What does RSP stand for in Railway Workshop Budgeting?

options.A: Rolling Stock Programme

questions.question: What does M&P stand for in Railway Budgeting?

options.A: Machinery and Plant

questions.question: Work Order system helps Management in Variance Analysis by comparing:

options.A: Actual costs incurred against Estimated / Standard costs

questions.question: What is 'Estimate' prepared by PCO before opening a custom/capital Work Order?

options.A: Detailed computation of anticipated material, labor hours, direct charges, and oncost
options.C: List of staff retiring this month

questions.question: What is 'Job Cost Sheet'?

options.A: Accounting document that compiles all direct labor, direct material, and overhead charges for a specific Work Order

questions.question: What is 'Batch Costing' under Work Order System?

options.A: Costing method where a cost unit consists of a group/batch of identical components produced under one Work Order
options.B: Costing of a single train journey

questions.question: In Metro Railway Kolkata, scheduled Overhaul of motor coach traction motors is executed under:

options.A: Specific Mechanical/Electrical Overhaul Work Order

questions.question: Which wing of PCO assigns the Work Order number and prepares job tickets?

options.A: Planning Wing

questions.question: Which wing of PCO verifies that work done on a Work Order complies with drawings before signing the completion ticket?

options.A: Inspection Wing

questions.question: What is 'Material Requisition Note' (Indent) linked with Work Order?

options.A: Document specifying exact item code, description, quantity, and Work Order number to which material must be charged

questions.question: If material drawn against a Work Order remains unused, what must shop floor staff do?

options.A: Return it to Stores via Advice Note of Returned Stores or transfer it via Advice of Material Transfer (Form S-1727)
options.D: Keep it hidden in locker indefinitely

questions.question: Form S-1727 in Railway Stores procedure is used for:

options.A: Advice of Material Transfer between jobs/work orders

questions.question: What is 'Administrative Oncost'?

options.A: Overhead expenses relating to top management, personnel, medical, and accounting services allocated to shop output
options.B: Cost of purchase of machine grease

questions.question: The total cost of a job executed under a Work Order is calculated as:

options.A: Direct Material + Direct Labor + Direct Expenses + Shop Oncost + General Oncost

questions.question: Under Railway rules, what is the maximum validity period generally allowed for a routine production Work Order if not extended?

options.A: Financial Year in which it is opened (or till currency specified in production program)

questions.question: What is a 'Out-turn Statement' prepared monthly by Workshop Accounts?

options.A: Statement showing total completed jobs and total costs credited/debited across all open work orders
options.C: Statement of diesel consumption in road vehicles

questions.question: If excess raw material is mistakenly drawn against a Work Order, the unit cost of the job will:

options.A: Falsely increase

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of 'Direct Expense' on a specialized Work Order?

options.A: Hiring specialized testing equipment or consultancy specifically for that single work order
options.D: Cost of soap provided in washrooms

questions.question: In Railway Workshop Accounting, what does 'WAP' stand for in monthly accountal?

options.A: Workshop Account Current / Workshop Accounting Procedure

questions.question: What is 'Re-work' cost booking?

options.A: Booking extra labor and material required to rectify a defective job onto a Rectification Work Order/Card

questions.question: If rework is required due to bad workmanship of shop staff, the rework cost is booked to:

options.A: Shop Oncost (Fault of Shop) Standing Work Order

questions.question: If rework is required due to defective raw material supplied by Store Depot, the cost is charged to:

options.A: Stores Suspense / Supplier rejection claim account

questions.question: What is the primary document used by Accounts to audit daily labor booking against Work Orders?

options.A: Daily Time Sheet / Muster Roll Tally Sheet

questions.question: Which category of staff is responsible for punching/booking start and finish times on Job Cards linked to Work Orders?

options.A: Direct Workers / Time Keeper / Shop Floor JE

questions.question: What is 'Work Order Master File' in computerization of workshop accounts?

options.A: Database containing details of all active work orders, description, account head, and validity
options.B: File containing list of retired trains

questions.question: In Metro Railway maintenance, Bogie Overhaul for Metro rakes is booked under:

options.A: Specific Bogie Overhaul Revenue Work Order

questions.question: What is 'Over-absorption of Oncost'?

options.A: When overheads charged to work orders using fixed percentage exceed the actual overhead expenses incurred
options.B: When shop absorbs too much water

questions.question: What is 'Under-absorption of Oncost'?

options.A: When overheads charged to work orders are less than the actual overhead expenses incurred
options.B: When shop floor is painted white
options.C: When machine runs at double speed

questions.question: How often are Oncost percentages reviewed by Workshop Accounts to avoid heavy under/over-absorption?

options.A: Periodically (usually semi-annually or annually)

questions.question: What is the main advantage of computerized Work Order System (e.g., WISE in Indian Railways)?

options.A: Real-time tracking of job progress, material consumption, and accurate cost allocation

questions.question: What does 'WISE' stand for in Indian Railway Workshop Management?

options.A: Workshop Information System Executable / Workshop Information System

questions.question: In WISE software, booking of job cards and material indents is directly validated against:

options.A: Active Work Order Master Data

questions.question: Work Orders for repair of workshop's own machine tools (Millwright work) are classified as:

options.A: Shop Oncost Standing Work Order (Maintenance of Plant & Machinery)

questions.question: Cost of electricity consumed by heavy machinery on the shop floor is booked under:

options.A: Standing Work Order for Power / Shop Oncost

questions.question: What is 'Job Card Punching'?

options.A: Recording the clock time of starting and ending a specific operation under a Work Order
options.D: Physical boxing match on shop floor

questions.question: What happens if a worker punches 'IN' on a new Job Card without punching 'OUT' on the previous Job Card?

options.A: Time overlap error occurs in time booking, requiring JE intervention to rectify

questions.question: What is 'Work Order Audit' conducted by Accounts?

options.A: Scrutiny to ensure material and labor booked match sanctioned estimates and physical output

questions.question: When a non-stock item is purchased locally for a specific Work Order, the cost is charged to:

options.A: The specific Work Order directly via Allocation Head

questions.question: What is the function of 'Allocation Code' attached to a Work Order?

options.A: It maps the work order expense to the correct demand for grant and accounting head of Indian Railways
options.C: It acts as PIN code of workshop
options.D: It acts as phone number of SSE

questions.question: Expenditure on POH of Metro Rolling stock is allocated under which Demand for Grant of Indian Railways budget?

options.A: Demand No. 6 (Repair & Maintenance of Carriage & Wagon / Rolling Stock)

questions.question: Capital expenditure on creation of new workshop facilities is allocated under:

options.A: Demand No. 16 (Assets - Acquisition, Construction and Replacement)

questions.question: What is 'Credit Note' in Workshop Accounting?

options.A: Accounting document reducing the debit on a Work Order for returned material or scrap credit

questions.question: What is 'Advice of Material Transfer' (AMT)?

options.A: Document used when material already drawn for Work Order 'A' is transferred to Work Order 'B' directly on shop floor

questions.question: Without AMT, if material drawn for Job A is used on Job B, what accounting error occurs?

options.A: Job A is overcharged (cost inflated) and Job B is undercharged (cost understated)

questions.question: What is 'Shop Sheet' or 'Operation Sheet'?

options.A: Detailed document listing step-by-step technical instructions, machine to be used, and standard time per operation
options.B: Bed sheet used in rest room

questions.question: Which officer holds overall administrative charge of a major Railway Repair Workshop?

options.A: Chief Works Manager (CWM)

questions.question: What is the role of Senior Section Engineer (Progress) regarding Work Orders?

options.A: Monitoring execution progress of work orders, ensuring material availability, and pushing job completion

questions.question: In modern Metro Railway maintenance depots, work orders are managed digitally using which enterprise software?

options.A: ERP / MAXIMO / SAP (Plant Maintenance module)

questions.question: What is 'Preventive Maintenance Work Order' in Metro Depot management?

options.A: Scheduled work order created for routine servicing (e.g., 3-day, 30-day, 180-day inspection) to prevent failures

questions.question: What is 'Breakdown Maintenance Work Order'?

options.A: Unscheduled work order opened immediately to record repairs and costs when equipment fails unexpectedly

questions.question: What is 'Cost Centre' in shop floor management?

options.A: A defined shop section or machine group to which overheads and costs can be distinctly allocated
options.B: The main cash office at railway station

questions.question: What is 'Standard Costing'?

options.A: Costing method that pre-determines standard costs for materials, labor, and overheads for comparison with actuals
options.B: Selling items at standard market price
options.C: Paying standard salary to all employees

questions.question: When actual labor hours spent on a Work Order are less than estimated hours, it results in:

options.A: Favorable Labor Efficiency Variance

questions.question: When actual material used on a Work Order exceeds the sanctioned estimate, it results in:

options.A: Unfavorable Material Usage Variance

questions.question: What is 'Reconciliation of Workshop Accounts'?

options.A: Matching labor and material costs booked in shop work orders with total debits in financial accounts

questions.question: Who signs the Work Completion Certificate to confirm that a Metro rake overhaul Work Order is physically finished?

options.A: Shop SSE / Divisional Officer and Quality Inspection Officer

questions.question: Final closure of a Work Order in Accounts involves:

options.A: Balancing debits and credits, clearing WMS, and transferring net cost to final revenue/capital heads
options.B: Tearing off the work order register pages
